title: S4-CART-01 — A living postcard brings the drawing back.
goal: A cart takes the project's own title, shows a card preview and announces that it saved the whole drawing; saving it never changes the drawing.

steps.say: Either the message "Cart saved. Anyone who opens it in PixiBun gets the whole drawing." appears, or the Export dialog has closed with no error message: the dialog closes only after a successful save, and a failed save keeps it open with the error.

either.text: Cart saved. Anyone who opens it in PixiBun gets the whole drawing.

cliOnly: opening the saved cart PNG in /open: it plays and reopens as an editable project with its frames, holds and pixels (tests/production/cartPlayer.spec.ts, tests/production/carts.spec.ts)
